verdict.rationale: Agent-readable docs are a fair axis for any product with public docs and an API, so this story applies to Jules. Probes found no llms.txt, no markdown docs endpoint and no OpenAPI spec (all HTTP 404), and nothing in the pack shows agent-oriented documentation for Jules itself. Jules reading AGENTS.md from a user's repo is the product consuming instructions, not publishing agent-oriented docs, so it is not credited here.
